keyVerseDR: "My sheep hear my voice. And I know them: and they follow me." (Jn 10:27)

level1.title: Jesus, My Shepherd
level1.story: Jesus said, "My sheep hear My voice. I know them, and they follow Me." No one can take them from His hand. Jesus and the Father are one.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How do you hear Jesus' voice?
level1.prayer: Good Shepherd, I will follow You. Amen.

activity.title: I hear His voice
activity.intro: Color a heart each day you listen to Jesus in prayer.

level2.title: No One Can Take Them
level2.story: Jesus said, "My sheep hear My voice: and I know them, and they follow Me." He said, "I give them life everlasting; and they shall not perish for ever." No man shall snatch them out of His hand. Jesus said His Father, who gave them to Him, is greater than all. "I and the Father are one."
level2.keyLine: My sheep hear my voice. And I know them: and they follow me.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why are we safe with Jesus?
What does 'The Father and I are one' mean?
level2.prayer: Jesus, keep me safe in Your hand. Amen.

activity.title: A shepherd saint
activity.intro: Read the clues. Who is it?
clues: I was a parish priest in Ars, France.
I heard confessions for many hours each day.
I am the patron saint of parish priests.

art.mainBrief: Shepherd holding sheep safely in his hands
art.heartBrief: Little sheep in heart; staff on side
